scripts.dev: npm run build -w @pos/shared && concurrently -k --kill-others-on-fail -n VITE,ELECTRON -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w @pos/renderer" "npm run dev -w @pos/electron"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pos/shared && npm run build -w @pos/electron && npm run build -w @pos/renderer
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @pos/electron
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pos/shared && npm run typecheck -w @pos/electron && npm run typecheck -w @pos/renderer
